QuestInfo.name: Silas Irons in Need of Help
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p504#, the master blacksmith of #m10004000#, needs some help. Maybe I should go check in on him.
QuestInfo.1: #p504#, the master blacksmith of #m10004000#, received an important request, but he's been struggling because he's short on materials. I need to defeat #r#o14#s#k and bring back #b#t4010102##k to help him out.
QuestInfo.2: I delivered the items #p504# requested without any issues. At this rate, I might really be considered a fine apprentice.

0.0: Good timing! #p511# of #m10004000# requested a special piece of armor for the town's warriors, but I'm short on the material needed to craft it. Could you help me out?

yes.0: Thanks! I need #b1 #t4010102##k for the armor. Please go defeat #r#o14#s#k in the #m10003000# region and bring one back for me. I'll be waiting!

no.0: An apprentice refusing a master's request... Back in my day, that would've been unthinkable...

1.0: Perfect! This is exactly what I needed. You really are a reliable apprentice!

yes.0: Here, take this #t2002007# as a reward. It'll make it a bit easier for you to train your blacksmithing skills.
yes.1: But this could be a problem... I have a feeling #p511# will keep sending requests like this. I might need your help again. I'll ask you next time!

mob.0: It looks like you haven't defeated all the monsters I mentioned. Please hurry!

item.0: It looks like you haven't collected the material I asked for. Please hurry!
